description: Phase 10 GAN augmentation, training-fold-only. One class-conditional DCGAN per CV fold, trained on that fold's fold_XX_train.csv rows only (validation fold and frozen final_test are runtime-forbidden ids). No supplied paper or project document specifies a GAN architecture (verified 2026-09-19 across ROADMAO/*, Review_dcouments/*, Research papers/*, team_divison_work/*, Data_training_results_technique3/*): cDCGAN is the project's own documented choice, not attributed to any paper. Synthetic amount policy (roadmap Phase 14: 'GAN should not automatically generate the same number of images for every class'): top every class of the training fold up to the fold's largest class, capped at 1.0 x the class's real count.

generation.format: PNG, RGB, image_size x image_size, values from tanh output mapped to [0, 255]
